question: can the pinned build typeset Korean without weakening the isolation guarantee

falsifier_check.claim: the font addition must not change anything but the font
falsifier_check.method: ran the unchanged English manuscript on the new revision before touching the preamble

isolation_rule.before: dependencies admitted only from the toolchain root or the temporary directory
isolation_rule.after: the same, plus exactly one font file copied from the pinned toolchain whose digest is verified at build time
isolation_rule.why_this_is_not_a_relaxation: the rule exists to forbid unpinned inputs. The font is pinned by digest and checked on every build, and a mismatch is reported as a dependency violation, so the set of unpinned inputs is still empty.
isolation_rule.rejected: admitting a system font, which would have allowed an input nobody pinned

korean_renders.verified_by: extracting text from the built PDF rather than trusting the compile exit code
korean_renders.page_one_extract: 장기 자율 연구개발을 위한 대규모 언어모델 에이전트 하네스의 설계와 평가
korean_renders.why_this_check_matters: the earlier toolchain compiled Korean successfully and silently produced no Korean at all, so a successful build is not evidence that the text is present
